pullRequest.title: Add X-Request-Id response header
pullRequest.description: Tags every response with an X-Request-Id header — reuses the caller's header if provided, otherwise generates a UUID. Useful for tracing requests through integrations.

summary.headline: Adds request tracing via X-Request-Id response header on all endpoints
summary.overview: This PR introduces Express middleware that sets an X-Request-Id response header on every HTTP response. If the incoming request already includes an X-Request-Id header, that value is echoed back; otherwise, a new UUID is generated using Node.js crypto.randomUUID(). No existing endpoints or response bodies are modified.

filesChanged.summary: Added crypto import and Express middleware to set X-Request-Id on all responses

detailedChanges.description: Added require('crypto') import to support UUID generation
Added Express middleware that runs before all route handlers. Sets res header X-Request-Id to the incoming X-Request-Id header value if present, otherwise generates a new UUID via crypto.randomUUID()

behavioralChanges.before: Responses did not include an X-Request-Id header
behavioralChanges.after: All responses include an X-Request-Id header
behavioralChanges.details: When a client sends X-Request-Id in the request, the same value is returned in the response. When absent, a server-generated UUID (e.g. 7505880b-e64f-4e04-86e8-4a7634f187cb) is returned.

behavioralChanges.before: No request correlation or tracing support
behavioralChanges.after: Requests can be correlated across services using the X-Request-Id header
behavioralChanges.details: Follows common distributed tracing conventions. Middleware is registered after express.json() and before route handlers, so it applies globally.

unaffectedAreas: Response body content for all endpoints
package.json dependencies (crypto is a Node.js built-in module)
